Sanae Kobayashi (Japanese: 小林沙苗 Kobayashi Sanae) is a Japanese voice actress for the . She was born on January 26, 1980 in , .

==Pokémon roles==
Kobayashi began to provide voices for the in as various characters of the day. Her most famous role is that of Greta.
